- Handle last-minute changes and troubleshoot logistical issues as they arise.
- Coordinate travel and logistics approximately 2-3 times per month, with the flexibility to accommodate changing needs.

- Draft and proofread professional emails, documents, presentations, and other correspondence.
- Communicate professionally with executives, clients, partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.
- Represent executives professionally when coordinating schedules, meetings, and requests.
- Manage sensitive information and maintain a high level of discretion and confidentiality.
- Use strong written and verbal communication skills to ensure information is communicated clearly and efficiently.
